findings.message: Unsupported: Protection needs its Of filter to name the colours protected from, and ObjectFilter's Colors/AnyColor/NotColors take printed colours only. No filter field, Predicate or Amount reads a player's commander's colour identity, so 'each color that's not in your commander's color identity' cannot be written; ManaProduction.CommanderIdentity says it for mana and nothing says it for an object filter. NotPredicate(SharesColorWith(Commander(You))) is not the same reading: colour identity is not colour, and per-colour protection still applies to a multicoloured object that shares one colour with the commander.
